vendor.quote: This DigitalOcean Service Level Agreement (“SLA”) governs your use of DigitalOcean Droplets

covered_services.quote: This DigitalOcean Service Level Agreement (“SLA”) governs your use of DigitalOcean Droplets and applies separately to each Droplet you use.

plan.missing_reason: The source does not mention a Standard plan or any plan tiers; the SLA applies to Droplets generally.

uptime_commitment_pct.quote: DigitalOcean commits to a Monthly Uptime Percentage of 99.99% for each individual Droplet instance.

measurement_period.quote: The percentage of time a droplet resource is available during a monthly billing cycle

timezone.missing_reason: The source does not name a time zone for measuring the month.

value.description: Monthly Uptime Percentage = (Total minutes in the month - Minutes of Unavailability) / Total minutes in the month, per Droplet resource during a monthly billing cycle. The definition of Unavailability is not given in the source.

downtime_definition.quote: Monthly Uptime Percentage: The percentage of time a droplet resource is available during a monthly billing cycle, calculated as: (Total minutes in the month - Minutes of Unavailability) / Total minutes in the month.

credit_tiers.quote:
| Monthly Uptime Percentage | Service Credit Percentage | |---|---|
| less than 99.99% | 100% |

credit_basis.quote: Service Credits apply only to charges incurred for the specific Droplet resources affected and are credited towards future invoices.

credit_cap.missing_reason: The source states a 100% service credit for uptime below 99.99% but does not state an explicit cap on total credits or its basis, so the cap is ambiguous.

min_credit.missing_reason: The source contains no minimum credit amount or threshold for issuing a credit.

exclusions.quote: This SLA does not cover Unavailability caused by:
exclusions.missing_reason: The source introduces a list of exclusions but the list items are not included in the text, so the specific exclusions cannot be determined.

prerequisites.missing_reason: The source does not state any claim prerequisites such as a support ticket, fully paid account, production instance, or authorized requester.

claim_window.quote: within two (2) billing cycles of the month when the downtime occurred
claim_window.section: Claim process (To request a Service Credit)

claim_procedure.quote: To request a Service Credit, contact DigitalOcean at success[@digitalocean](/community/users/digitalocean).com within two (2) billing cycles of the month when the downtime occurred. Include the email address associated with your account, affected Droplet resource details, and outage dates/times.
